caption: The drawing depicts the design of a rectangular wooden door or cabinet panel, primarily rendered in shades of brown. The front view shows the panel divided vertically into three equally sized sections, each with three decorative, outlined shapes evenly spaced along the height. These shapes have a polygonal, scalloped edge and are bordered with dark lines to highlight their design. The sides and bottom of the panel are outlined with thin black lines, indicating the edges and joints. On the right side of the drawing, there is a vertical cross-section of the panel with a dimension line labeled "6' 10 1/2"" to indicate height. Below the main front view, a horizontal cross-section of the base is shown, marked with a dimension "3' 8 1/2"". The background of the drawing is off-white, and all lines and shading are executed in brown and black ink with watercolor-style coloring used for the panel surfaces.
title: Sacristy Door
